# Philips N4520 Player v0.0.14

## Added

- Added optional Music Assistant Sendspin VU source support to the Home
  Assistant card.
- Vendored a browser-compatible `@sendspin/sendspin-js` 3.2.0 ESM bundle into
  the HACS `dist/` artifact so the card can connect to MA Sendspin without an
  external CDN dependency.
- Added card config fields for Sendspin enablement, endpoint URL, optional auth
  token, player ID, and client name.

## Changed

- VU source priority is now HA level entities, Sendspin decoded PCM, then fake
  fallback.

## Notes

- This is the first Sendspin integration pass. The card can connect as a
  Sendspin client and derive levels from decoded PCM; practical use still
  depends on making the MA Sendspin target/grouping flow line up with the
  playback queue.
